integrity: Proof is analytic and all-size; finite checker is supporting exact evidence only. Literature comparisons are limited to inspected material and reported searches.
scientific_limitations: Only equal-spaced branch fixed points and independent uniform cuts.
Almost-sure dynamics exclude cuts exactly on branch fixed points.
General local-time probability phenomena are prior background; no claim of a novel Rayleigh distribution outside this dynamical identification.
No independent audit; historical priority beyond inspected sources not certified.
title: Rayleigh attractor-count law for uniformly cut increasing contractions
